photos.c: The Belgrave Boys pose before the Winter's first Surrey League match at Wimbledon. Standing, left to right: Michael Manning and daughter, Ray Foley, Mick Graham, 'Gerry' Adams, John Mather, Rob Harding,Paul Roche, Junior Galley, a yawning John Gladwin who's seen it all before, Stu' Paton, Pete Gilbey, Tony Binda, Colin Preston, Roger Alsop, Charlie Dickinson, Marlon Anderson, Bruce Barton, Jesper Madsen, Alex Luce, Rex Bale, Steve Willimont, Tony Stone, Alan Mead, John Wasbrough. Kneeling: ?, Jim Estall, Markand Patel, Paul Graham, Peter McDonald, ?, Kevin Quinn, Amir Becirhodzic, Bernard Asante, Stephen 'Maggot' Quinn, John Wilson, Adam Jones.

Kevin Quinn is making good progress in Junior Cross Country races this winter, his first in the age group. Already Merton Schools Senior Boys Champion - a race he won by well over two minutes - he is now targetting the English Schools.

Eighteen year-old Kevin Quinn continues to carve a niche for himself.  1997 saw him competing in Southern Men's, National Junior, and Rosenheim Leagues.  He is the Junior Men's Cross Country Champion and he has already been voted the 1998 Junior Men's T&F Captain.
Kevin Quinn sets off on his stage of the Walton Road Relay where he moved our team into 2nd place.

Above: Belgrave's South of Thames Championship winning team 1999 - Rob Harding, Charlie Dickinson, Kevin Quinn, Phil Carstairs (obscured), Paul Coughlan, Roger Alsop, Mike Kazimierski, Jerome Curtat (behind), Don Anderson, Najibe Hliouat, Saul Armanini and Graham Adams. The man missing from this shot is Will Cockerell.
Kevin Quinn and Ray Foley race down the Brockwell Park slopes ahead of Thames H&H's Dave Hill in Surrey League Race One.
Rob Harding, Ray Foley, Mike Webb, Clive Gilby, Kevin Quinn, Jim Estall John Mather and Lee Hurst steel themselves for the start of the first Surrey League race of 1998-99.

The traditional team photo before the start of the first Surrey League Race. Back row - Bruce Barton, Geremew Wolde, Rex Bale, Mike Webb, Don Anderson, Gerry Adams, Darryl Ochse, Alasdair McLean Foreman, Roger Alsop, Adam Cowmeadow, Tony Barden, Kevin Quinn, Pete Gilbey, Harry Corbett, Erwenn Lemenager, Rob Harding, Andy Brown, Ted Pallant. Left: Wimbledon Park, September 2000 and “Skipper” Roger Alsop starts his “stag party” celebrations by handing over to Kevin Quinn in 3rd place at the end of stage 1 of the Surrey Road Relay.
